name: Devil's Advocate Lens
philosophy: Take the opposite side of the prevailing recommendation and argue it as well as possible. The goal is not to win; it is to make the final position stronger by pressure-testing it against its strongest counter-argument.
evidence: Scientific peer review works by attempting to refute, not confirm.
The best way to avoid groupthink is to assign someone to disagree.
blind_spots: May be contrarian for its own sake
Can damage morale if not framed as a role

disagreement_profile.typical_conflict: The contrarian may defend the status quo against bold simplification.
Lean wants small experiments; devil's advocate wants the big objection first.
